decisions.evidence: Accepted the exact post-snapshot finite-chain repair after independently reviewing all three steps, the face-relative smoothing statement, and Guillemin–Pollack printed pp.68–73 and107–114. The preimage at Git66722d74a12f93db6f4ac2e890c655e1e60286d1 matches the pre raw hash and omits the needed rational-chain model and literal Q end collar. Current1.1 supplies face-compatible smoothing, independently labeled factors, relative general position, compact diagonal intersections and oriented cancellation;1.2 supplies the collar and correct outward-normal-first sign. Statement unchanged. The existing batch76 closed row records this same repaired supplier defect and its separately qualified historical observations.

Accepted the exact post-snapshot unified locally flat construction after reading all six steps and exact normal-bundle, strongly relative transversality, CW-type and circle-map inputs. The recovered preimage at Git66722d74a12f93db6f4ac2e890c655e1e60286d1 matches its pre raw hash; it interleaves smooth/TOP exteriors and contains nonexistent8.x references. Current proof checks the doubled sphere seam germ, local complement pi1=Z and pi2=0, zero framing via disjoint ambient-chain replacements, meridian map extension, boundary-relative graph transversality, restricted trivial normal product and radial sector gluing. No embedded smoothing is inferred. Existing closed batch75 row records the repaired historical reference defect. Statement unchanged.

Confirmed nonfatal refuter finding: old Proof3.1 asserted smooth bounding chains in R and a smooth neighborhood model although F5 gives only a locally flat embedded R, even for smooth disks. F6 does not license that inference. Removed the redundant smooth subproof and duplicate TOP rank/saturation paragraphs. The four-step proof now applies to every locally flat disk: finite TOP homology and duality give kernel rank g, continuous chains push apart in the actual normal product, chain smoothing occurs only in disjoint smooth ambient neighborhoods, rational Gaussian elimination preserves boundaries and support, and saturation gives a primitive rank-g summand. No change to Statement, Definition or dependencies; contract step/citation/axiom uses and boundaries refreshed. This completed repair supersedes the earlier batch75 maintenance-only row.
